title: Apply composition in a small program
rationale: Synthetic theory evidence mock-evidence-7-theory-1 scores 1.0 while reviewed coding evidence mock-evidence-7-code-1 scores 0.0. This suggests a possible theory-to-practice gap requiring review.
lesson: Composition combines objects. Let a Library object hold a Catalog object and delegate lookups to it.
exercise: Implement a Library that receives a Catalog object and uses its lookup method. Write a test using a small fake Catalog.
success_criteria: In a new educator-reviewed exercise, demonstrate delegation and explain why the relationship uses composition. Compare new evidence with the baseline.
